SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND 1.0 * s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND sat.NumGE1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(sat2.NumGE1500)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS sat2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
        AND s2.Charter = 1
        AND s2.StatusType = 'Active'
        AND sat2.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.District,
        s.County,
        t.AvgScrWrite,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS t
        ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
      AND t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, District, County, AvgScrWrite
FROM eligible
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY School;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter,
        ROUND(
            f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS free_pct,
        ROUND(
            f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm AS f
    WHERE f.`County Name` = (
        SELECT `County Name`
        FROM frpm
        WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
    )
      AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
),
sat AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total_score
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    e.county,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.free_pct), 2) AS average_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct), 2) AS average_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2) AS average_sat_score
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN sat AS s
    ON s.cds = e.CDSCode
GROUP BY e.county;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.District AS district,
    s.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12,
    t.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    t.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
    t.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
    t.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
    t.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_score_at_least_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.County,
        s.City,
        s.MailStreet,
        s.MailCity,
        s.MailState,
        s.MailZip,
        s.Website,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS frpm_share,
        s.OpenDate,
        s.ClosedDate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND s.Charter = 0
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
),
largest AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count = (SELECT MAX(frpm_count) FROM eligible)
),
smallest_share AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count IS NOT NULL
      AND frpm_share = (
          SELECT MIN(frpm_share)
          FROM eligible
          WHERE frpm_count IS NOT NULL
      )
),
selected AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, 1 AS part_order FROM largest
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, 'smallest FRPM share', 2 FROM smallest_share
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, 'the CDS code from my notes', 3
    FROM eligible
    WHERE CDSCode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT
    selected.part,
    e.School AS school_name,
    e.County AS county,
    e.City AS city,
    e.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    e.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    e.MailState AS mailing_state,
    e.MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    e.Website AS website,
    e.enrollment_k12 AS k12_enrollment,
    e.frpm_count AS frpm_eligible_student_count,
    e.frpm_share AS frpm_share,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS average_total_sat_score,
    sat.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS percentage_sat_takers_scoring_1500_or_more,
    e.OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN e.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM selected
JOIN eligible AS e ON e.CDSCode = selected.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = e.CDSCode
ORDER BY selected.part_order, e.CDSCode;

SELECT
    s.cname AS county_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS qualifying_schools
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY s.cname
ORDER BY qualifying_schools DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS magnet_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND (
    cardKingdomId IS NULL OR trim(cardKingdomId) = ''
    OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR trim(cardKingdomFoilId) = ''
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f
    ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    AND f.language = 'French'
WHERE c.power IS NULL
   OR instr(c.power, '*') > 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code)
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cardKingdomId) <> ''
             AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cardKingdomFoilId) <> ''
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'CSP';

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year_span
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*';

WITH abyssal_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code) AS rn
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT code, name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC) AS rn
    FROM sets
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT code, name FROM abyssal_sets WHERE rn = 1
    UNION
    SELECT code, name FROM latest_set WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT chosen.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                    AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> ''
                    AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END
           ) / COUNT(c.id),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM chosen
JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = chosen.code
GROUP BY chosen.code, chosen.name
ORDER BY chosen.code;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(otherFaceIds) <> ''
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT frameVersion
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
      ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fd.name AS japanese_name,
        c.type AS english_type,
        c.uuid
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
ruling_totals AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT
    q.japanese_name,
    q.english_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(rt.ruling_count, 0)) AS total_rulings
FROM qualifying AS q
LEFT JOIN ruling_totals AS rt
    ON rt.uuid = q.uuid
GROUP BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type
ORDER BY q.japanese_name, q.english_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

WITH official_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
),
language_printings AS (
    SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM foreign_data AS fd
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
    JOIN official_languages AS ol ON ol.language = fd.language
    GROUP BY fd.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM language_printings
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM language_printings)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
  AND ph.UserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

WITH germany_last_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
post_groups AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
                THEN 'Germany-based last editor'
            ELSE 'All other posts'
        END AS post_group,
        SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY post_group
),
editor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS editor_count,
        SUM(Reputation) AS combined_reputation
    FROM germany_last_editors
)
SELECT
    pg.post_group,
    pg.total_score,
    es.editor_count AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
    es.combined_reputation AS germany_users_combined_reputation
FROM post_groups pg
CROSS JOIN editor_stats es
ORDER BY CASE pg.post_group
    WHEN 'Germany-based last editor' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
END;

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS l
JOIN posts AS p
  ON p.Id = CASE
      WHEN l.PostId = 4220 THEN l.RelatedPostId
      ELSE l.PostId
  END
WHERE (l.PostId = 4220 OR l.RelatedPostId = 4220)
  AND p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
  AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%'
  AND Views = (
      SELECT MAX(Views)
      FROM users
      WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
        AND Location NOT LIKE '%Canada%'
  );

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
related_counts AS (
    SELECT c.Id, c.Title, COUNT(pl.Id) AS related_count
    FROM candidates AS c
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
        ON pl.PostId = c.Id
       AND pl.LinkTypeId = 1
    GROUP BY c.Id, c.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_count
FROM related_counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM related_counts)
ORDER BY Title;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation), 2)
FROM users AS u
WHERE TRIM(LOWER(u.Location)) = 'india'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts AS p
      WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
        AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
        AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  );

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201301'
      AND y.Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_totals
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT Segment, CustomerID, total
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT total FROM chosen WHERE Segment = 'SME'),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2) AS average_monthly_fuel_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date >= '201301'
  AND Date < '201401'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date <= '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT c.Currency, AVG(a.consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM annual a
    JOIN customers c USING (CustomerID)
    WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
    GROUP BY c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM avgs;

WITH extreme_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
       OR height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),
average_finishing AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, AVG(a.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM extreme_players p
    JOIN Player_Attributes a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM average_finishing
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS date
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  );

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        volleys,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT m.country_id, m.id AS match_id, p.player_id
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN (
        SELECT id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
        UNION ALL SELECT id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
    ) AS p ON p.id = m.id
    WHERE p.player_id IS NOT NULL
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.id AS country_id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS player_match_count
    FROM match_players AS mp
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = mp.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_match_count = (SELECT MIN(player_match_count) FROM country_counts);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2013-07-12 00:00:00'
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN player_api_id = 30700 THEN overall_rating END) - AVG(overall_rating))
    * 100.0 / AVG(overall_rating),
    2
)
FROM ratings;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = t.account_id
 AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT branch_district.district_id
    FROM district AS branch_district
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = branch_district.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE branch_district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_average_salary,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM qualifying_districts AS q
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = q.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT c.district_id, AVG(d.A11) AS district_avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp owner_disp
          WHERE owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
            AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM disp any_disp
                JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = any_disp.disp_id
                WHERE any_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
            )
      )
    GROUP BY c.district_id
);

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS household_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '' THEN t.trans_id END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND t.amount > 4000;

WITH markets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.type,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        d.A8 AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS p ON p.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = p.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
)
SELECT type, district, inhabitants
FROM (
    SELECT
        type,
        district,
        inhabitants,
        MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY type) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM markets
)
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY type, district;

WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_orders AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        w.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(s.total_standing_order_debit, 0) * 1.0 / ac.account_count AS avg_standing_order_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawals AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account_counts AS ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing_orders AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(avg_standing_order_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM metrics
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
                 AND bank IS NOT NULL
                 AND account IS NOT NULL
            THEN bank || ':' || account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_details AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        district.A2 AS district_name,
        district.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    number_of_loans,
    external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM account_details
ORDER BY rank, account_id;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01'
       OR c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31'
)
SELECT
    cohort,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_accounts AS ca
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ca.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT raceId, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN entry.laps = winner.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM results AS entry
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = entry.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = entry.raceId
JOIN winners AS winner ON winner.raceId = entry.raceId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lt.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q1) <> ''
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q2.q1) <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q1)
      FROM qualifying
      WHERE raceId = r.raceId
        AND q1 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q1) <> ''
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q_other.driverId) AS drivers_outqualified
FROM qualifying AS q_lucas
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q_lucas.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q_lucas.driverId
JOIN qualifying AS q_other ON q_other.raceId = q_lucas.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
  AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
  AND q_lucas.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q_other.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q_lucas.position < q_other.position;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 < '1:40.000';

SELECT ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) <> '' THEN 1 END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId),
    2
) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1992-01-01';

SELECT d.code AS driver_code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
      WHERE r2.year = 2017
        AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      ) < 98.000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS withdrawn_drivers
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT
  (SELECT b.amount
   FROM budget AS b
   JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
   WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
     AND b.category = 'Advertisement') * 1.0
  / (SELECT b.amount
     FROM budget AS b
     JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
     WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'
       AND b.category = 'Advertisement') AS ratio;

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
highest_ratio AS (
    SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT event_ratios.event_name
FROM event_ratios
JOIN highest_ratio
    ON event_ratios.spending_ratio = highest_ratio.spending_ratio;

WITH department_majors AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        major_id,
        major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE department IN (
        SELECT department
        FROM major
        WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
    )
),
major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major_id,
        dm.major_name,
        COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM department_majors AS dm
    LEFT JOIN member AS m
        ON m.link_to_major = dm.major_id
    GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id, dm.major_name
)
SELECT
    department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END,
        ', '
    ) AS majors_held_by_members,
    ROUND(SUM(member_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major_member_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department_name;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT a.type AS event_type,
       a.members_attended,
       COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget_dollars
FROM attendance_by_type AS a
LEFT JOIN budget_by_type AS b ON b.type = a.type
ORDER BY a.type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount)
FROM attendance AS a
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN income AS i ON i.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  AND i.source = 'Dues';

WITH chip_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
),
event_max AS (
    SELECT ce.event_id, MAX(b.amount) AS max_line_amount
    FROM chip_events ce
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ce.event_id
    GROUP BY ce.event_id
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event_max em
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = em.event_id
WHERE em.max_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) FROM event_max)
ORDER BY e.event_name;

SELECT e.expense_description, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, e.expense_description ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE lower(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE lower(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.full_name) <> ''
ORDER BY s.full_name;

WITH dc_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power AS hp
  JOIN superhero AS h ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
marvel_characters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.id, h.height_cm
  FROM superhero AS h
  JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
  JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dc_powers AS d
      WHERE d.power_id = hp.power_id
    )
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm)
FROM marvel_characters;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) NOT IN ('good', 'bad')
   OR a.alignment IS NULL;

SELECT g.gender, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hp.power_count >= 10
GROUP BY g.gender
ORDER BY CASE g.gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 1 WHEN 'Female' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE r.race IN ('God / Eternal', 'Eternal')
      AND g.gender = 'Male'
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
  AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.id, r.race
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(race_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
        FROM superhero
        WHERE publisher_id = (
            SELECT publisher_id
            FROM superhero
            WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
        )
          AND race_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY race_id
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg < 70
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm = (
    SELECT MIN(height_cm)
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON alignment.id = superhero.alignment_id
WHERE alignment.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(full_name) <> '-';

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM qualifying_patients;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GLU >= 180
      AND l.`T-CHO` < 250
);

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
) AS female_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-56 years')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PT >= 14
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP LIKE '%+%'
  AND (p.Description IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(p.Description AS TEXT)) = '');

SELECT p.ID, l.Date, l.DNA
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      JOIN Patient AS p2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID
      WHERE p2.SEX = 'F'
        AND p2.Admission = '+'
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(l2.DNA) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 600
  AND l.LDH < 800
  AND (
      CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      OR l."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND (`U-PRO` = '300' OR `U-PRO` = '>=300')
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250
  AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 4;

WITH qualifying_ldh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH >= 500
),
qualifying_protein AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '>=*'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(`U-PRO`, 3) AS REAL) >= 100
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '+*(*'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(`U-PRO`, INSTR(`U-PRO`, '(') + 1) AS REAL) >= 100
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '[0-9]*'
            THEN CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 100
        ELSE 0
    END
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_ldh AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN qualifying_protein AS u ON u.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  );

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'P' AND a2.element = 'N')
   OR (a1.element = 'N' AND a2.element = 'P');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_bond_group AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(b.bond_id)
      THEN 'all_single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule_bond_group
GROUP BY bond_group;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN lower(a.element) = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    WHEN lower(a2.element) = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id
END) AS atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE lower(a.element) = 'cl' OR lower(a2.element) = 'cl';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
  )
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id;

SELECT b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT
             CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
                  THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
                  ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
             END) AS element_pair_count,
       m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC;
